title: In 2023, teams began removing invasive spotted bass from South Africa's Breekkrans River
summary_full: A dedicated conservation initiative along the Breekkrans River is tackling the dangers of invasive spotted bass. The project aims to safeguard the critically endangered doring fiery redfin, which is currently struggling for survival. By eradicating these invasive fish, the redfin’s habitat will expand, giving it a better chance of thriving. Innovative removal methods are employed while also creating job opportunities for the local community, thereby bolstering freshwater conservation efforts.
